caption_used: Distribution of Quantifiers and Operations in Categorical, Approximate Number Generation, and Disjunctive & Conjunctive Reasoning. model_annotation: This pie chart visualizes the distribution of quantifiers and operations across three reasoning types: Categorical, Approximate Number Generation, and Disjunctive & Conjunctive. The chart consists of three separate pie charts, each with a varying number of slices. The Categorical pie chart contains four slices labeled Universal Quantifiers (light blue, 29.07%), Negation (coral, 27.91%), Limiter (pink, 27.91%), and Existential Quantifiers (lavender, 15.12%). The Approximate Number Generation pie chart includes three slices: Comparative Relationships (light teal, 36.26%), Approximate Quantities (yellow, 45.03%), and Absolute Absence (red, 18.71%). Finally, the Disjunctive & Conjunctive pie chart features two slices: Disjunctive (light purple, 49.51%) and Conjunctive (plum, 50.49%). Each pie chart includes percentage labels displayed within the slices, and a legend is present to identify each category and its corresponding color. The slices within each chart appear to be ordered from largest to smallest proportion.
